request_user:
Fact: out_of_scope_uses
What to find: Uses or AI systems the model is not intended or should not be used for.
Card sections that often contain it: Out-of-Scope Use, Out of Scope, Limitations

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Not a general assistant or chat model; it is tuned for formal logic only. It has no safety tuning beyond the base model's and no instruction-following alignment (IFEval regressed slightly). No claim is made about code generation or tool use.
quotes:
It is not a general assistant: there is no safety or preference tuning here beyond what SmolLM3
carries, and instruction following regressed slightly.

**Not a chat model.** It was optimised against automatic verifiers on logic tasks. It has had no
safety tuning beyond whatever the base model carries, and no instruction-following alignment
work — IFEval regressed slightly.

**Scope.** Tuned for formal logic. The Track B suite does not cover code generation or tool use
(HumanEval, LiveCodeBench and BFCL were not run for this model or its base), so this release
makes no claim about those.
